name: labs/czbiohub-sf__python-fish-sorter
title: Fish Sorter pneumatic valve controller (Wago, Modbus TCP)
intro: Fish Sorter pneumatic valve controller (Wago, Modbus TCP), adapted from czbiohub-sf/python-fish-sorter. It reads `function_code` and `function_echo`; sets `draw_time_ms` and `expel_time_ms`; runs `set_pressure`, `set_vacuum`, `idle_atmospheric` and `safe_pneumatics`. `set_pressure`: pressure on or off: writes the upstream press_on or press_off code and waits until the controller has taken it. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
